IGP field work identified and delimited geodynamic processes and ravines active during rainy periods
the report contains district/station rainfall context but does not provide child-specific event-paired rainfall-flow series
forbidden_inferences: the report figure may be digitized directly as reproducible child geometry without an independently frozen georeferencing method

district or station rainfall values are child-level activation thresholds

sources.document: Plan de Prevención y Reducción del Riesgo de Desastres de la Provincia de Paita 2019-2021
admissible_claims: El Zanjón drains much of Paita Baja through a channel toward the sea and overflow/inundation is reported for the 1983 El Niño period
La Piscina drains toward the 13 de Julio sector and toward El Zanjón
La Catarata drains from Paita Alta toward El Zanjón through San Martín Central and San Martín Occidente
Villa Naval drains from behind Villa Naval toward the Rada del Complejo Pesquero, with a separate marine outlet context
forbidden_inferences: reported routing descriptions are reproducible line geometry
described channel dimensions or works are current hydraulic capacity
the 1983 El Zanjón record may be transferred to every upstream ravine
Villa Naval must be forced into El Zanjón solely because another source summarizes the drainage generically

sources.document: Mapa de Peligros, Plan de Usos del Suelo y Plan de Mitigación de los Efectos Producidos por los Desastres Naturales en la Ciudad de Paita
admissible_claims: Nueva Esperanza is described as an east-to-west temporary ravine whose historical routing toward El Zanjón was modified by urban development
La Piscina historically joined the Nueva Esperanza drainage before reaching El Zanjón
La Catarata is described as draining to El Zanjón
Villa Naval is described as draining directly toward the sea near the former Pesca Perú area
forbidden_inferences: historic routing descriptions guarantee unchanged current morphology
the document supplies present-day reproducible geometry without geospatial recovery
historic qualitative flow statements are discharge observations or thresholds
urban modification may be reconstructed by interpolation without source geometry

2017 produced pluvial inundation in Paita Alta blind depressions and inundation context in Paita Baja/El Zanjón
Paita Alta blind basins are a pluvial-depression mechanism distinct from natural ravine routing
forbidden_inferences: all named ravines are individually confirmed activated in 2017
blind basins are natural ravines or share El Zanjón activation state
hazard zoning is an observed event footprint or IRFEN risk class

villa_naval.source_conflict_note: IGP 2021 gives a generic statement that the named Paita ravines drain through El Zanjón; more specific PPRRD/INDECI descriptions keep Villa Naval as a separate marine-outlet branch pending spatial adjudication
